description: Opt-in: every Renovate PR may auto-merge, but only after the Claude gate approved it (e-llabo/aube-workflows .github/actions/renovate-gate). A repository extends this ONLY when it runs the gate and its ruleset requires a review: without a required approval or check, auto-merge would merge on its own. Extend it after github>e-llabo/.github so these rules win. The exclusions keep the organisation preset's automerge: false for the e-llabo workflow pins and the manually checksummed tool pins.
